threshold: Repeated order and exact amount; only second and later invoice flagged
evidence_required: Invoice/order IDs, invoice number, line detail
recommended_investigation: Match customer PO, shipment quantities and payment; confirm validity before reversal
recommended_control: Prevent duplicate order billing; require controller override

threshold: No shipment lines for invoiced order
accounting_risk: Unsupported sale or missing interface evidence
false_positives: Missing carrier extract; service sale; bill-and-hold arrangement
recommended_investigation: Obtain carrier acceptance and contract; inspect subsequent shipment
recommended_control: Block invoice release until shipping evidence is linked

threshold: Recognition date earlier than last shipment
accounting_risk: Revenue recognized before assumed control transfer
evidence_required: Recognition date, complete shipment history, contract
false_positives: Partial delivery requires line-level recognition; contractual exceptions
recommended_investigation: Inspect dispatch proof and contract; determine appropriate recognition by line
recommended_control: Derive recognition from approved shipment event

threshold: Shipment, recognition or posting months differ
false_positives: Legitimate posting lag or accounting correction
recommended_investigation: Review month-end shipments and posting batch; assess affected periods
recommended_control: Daily interface monitoring and month-end cutoff review

threshold: Any difference of at least 1 cent
accounting_risk: Billing, shipping valuation or GL interface difference
evidence_required: Order, invoice header/lines, shipment value, GL AR/revenue
test_logic: Compare independently aggregated order, invoice, shipment and GL amounts
false_positives: Approved price changes or partial fulfillment
recommended_investigation: Trace line quantities, approved prices and GL mapping; resolve exact difference
recommended_control: Automated matching with documented price override approval

evidence_required: Roles, permissions, journal and activity log
false_positives: Emergency access may be documented externally
recommended_investigation: Review access grant and journal support; obtain independent assessment
recommended_control: Restrict posting access and recertify quarterly

threshold: No independent authorized approval by posting date
evidence_required: Journal, preparer, approver role, approval/posting date
false_positives: External approval not captured in extract
recommended_investigation: Inspect evidence of approval before posting and business rationale
recommended_control: Require independent controller approval before journal release

threshold: Same actor created invoice and applied cash; actor has both permissions
evidence_required: Effective permissions and transaction-level activity logs
exposure_basis: 0: control weakness alone does not estimate monetary error
false_positives: Approved small-team access with strong compensating review
recommended_investigation: Inspect logs and compensating review; reassign incompatible roles
recommended_control: Separate billing and cash roles; independent daily review

threshold: Sum of applications exceeds payment by at least 1 cent
recommended_investigation: Trace bank receipt and remittance; correct allocation with approval
recommended_control: Enforce cumulative allocation <= receipt in application workflow

threshold: Remitting customer differs from invoice customer
accounting_risk: Incorrect customer AR and collection follow-up
evidence_required: Payment remitter, invoice customer and remittance
exposure_basis: Misapplied amount; company total AR may be unchanged
recommended_investigation: Obtain remittance and customer hierarchy; transfer application if needed
recommended_control: Require verified payer relationship for cross-customer application

threshold: Allocation precedes receipt or recognition date
false_positives: Advance cash should be a deposit until sale
recommended_investigation: Trace bank value date; move advance to customer deposits
recommended_control: Date validation and unapplied cash review

threshold: Cumulative credits exceed invoice by at least 1 cent
accounting_risk: Excess reduction in AR and net revenue
recommended_investigation: Inspect return receipt and concession approval; investigate credit balance
recommended_control: Cumulative credit cap with independent override

threshold: At least 3 fully settled invoices paid after due date by as-of date
evidence_required: Payment allocations, contractual due date and credits
test_logic: customer_risk.sql: count late fully settled invoices >= 3
false_positives: Disputes, revised terms or processing delays
recommended_investigation: Review disputes, subsequent receipts and credit limits; assess allowance separately
recommended_control: Monthly credit review and escalation of repeat late payers
success_measure: Review all customers with >=3 late settlements

threshold: Customer represents at least 10% of YTD gross invoiced sales
exposure_basis: 0: dependency alone is not an accounting loss
recommended_investigation: Assess contract renewal, credit limits, aging and alternate markets
recommended_control: Quarterly concentration review and approved customer limits
success_measure: Review every customer >=10% of YTD gross sales
